thread:
Nora (Marketing): Heads-up — eu-west flake overnight. We need a short, clear customer cadence and instructions for our webinar in 48h. Proposing a comms plan and templates, please review.
Elliot (Comms): Thanks. Drop the cadence and I'll edit the language for external vs account emails.
Nora (Marketing): Cadence proposal: T0: status page + social; T+20m: support macros + AE ping for affected accounts; T+90m: technical update; T+24h: full postmortem + bench note. Also targeted note to webinar registrants (short).
Priya (Support): For routing, please add: auto-create tickets for accounts flagged as "SLA" or "Enterprise" and notify Renee + oncall. I'll prep macros.
Renee (Sales Ops): Confirmed — send list of affected accounts; if monthly_spend > 8k tag as "priority-sales". We'll notify AEs.
Max (SRE): Quick status: mitigation rolled out at 03:12 UTC, we still see elevated retries for a slice of hosts. ETA for stabilization ~2 hours.
Elliot (Comms): Language notes: public: keep non-technical. Account email: include mitigation time and offer failover help. Webinar: reassure and offer reschedule link if they want.
Nora (Marketing): Can someone draft the webinar line? I suggest: "Small platform disruption in eu-west was detected and mitigated; the webinar remains on schedule. If you need to reschedule, reply and we'll help."
Priya (Support): Canned reply example (short): "Thanks — we're aware of a transient issue impacting inference in eu-west. Engineers applied a mitigation at 03:12 UTC and we're monitoring. Please retry and see status.redwood.ai for updates. If you're an enterprise customer we'll escalate immediately."
Elliot (Comms): Status page template (brief): "Investigating: some inference requests routed to eu-west are experiencing elevated latency/errors. Mitigation applied; monitoring. Next update in 30 minutes."
Max (SRE): Technical snippet for account emails: "Root cause: intermittent network fabric disruption affecting a subset of GPU hosts. Mitigation: dynamic traffic reroute + retries. Customers on Reserved/Dedicated capacity may see transient impact; contact your AE for options."
Renee (Sales Ops): A/B test idea for follow-up subject lines to churn-risk customers: A) "Issue resolved — summary & credits" B) "Post-incident: what we changed and why" — we can measure opens and follow-ups.
Elliot (Comms): If we promise credits, finance sign-off needed. I'll loop finance/legal before any public credit language.
status-bot: "Finance paged: ticket FIN-3498 opened for incident credit approval."
Priya (Support): Translation priority: FR, DE, ES for EU incidents. Elliot — can you own?
Elliot (Comms): Yep, will do. Also recommend canonical link policy: link everything to status.redwood.ai and use targeted emails only for dedicated/reserved accounts.
Nora (Marketing): Action owners: Elliot = comms + translations, Priya = support macros + routing, Max = technical updates, Renee = account list routing + AE notifications, Nora = webinar registrant message + A/B config.
Priya (Support): I'll push macros to Helpdesk now and add escalation playbook for AEs.
Elliot (Comms): Drafting final copy now. Posting to #ops-marketing-assets when ready.
Nora (Marketing): Thanks team — keep this channel for approvals only. I'll publish the webinar line once Elliot confirms translations.
